"Rocket League style scene: a futuristic soccer match played with rocket-powered cars. Chunky, compact battle cars like the Octane, with boxy bodies, oversized off-road wheels, big rear spoilers and rocket boosters at the back, leaving bright boost trails of fire and smoke. One team is blue, the other is orange, and the cars carry matching team colors and decals. A giant soccer ball, about 3 times taller than a car, silver-grey with a dark hexagon panel pattern and glowing seams. The arena is an enclosed stadium with curved walls that ramp up into the sides and ceiling, so cars can drive on them. Big glowing goals at each end, one blue and one orange, with a neon goal frame. Glowing orange boost pads on the grass field, a bright white center line and a center circle. Packed crowd stands, stadium floodlights and a giant scoreboard with a match timer. Cars flying through the air, doing aerials and flips, with sparks and a colorful goal explosion. Stylized semi-realistic Unreal Engine game look, vibrant saturated colors, high energy, dynamic action camera, 3rd-person gameplay view.

---
This is a build request. Build a complete, playable game now (or apply the requested change to the existing game). Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and note them briefly when you finish.

Screenshots for your own checks: save small JPEGs (a .jpg path, viewport at most 1280px wide) and read only the latest one; older images are dropped from context. Read a full-size PNG only when fine detail matters.
"

- Build a complete, playable rocket-powered soccer game inspired by the requested futuristic arena match.

- Implemented as a standalone HTML5 Canvas game with no external dependencies.
- Used WASD/arrows to drive, Space to jump/flip, Shift to boost, R to reset, and Escape/pause button to pause.

- Added a playable Canvas game with 3D-projected arena, cars, ball, bots, boost pads, goals, scoring, timer, HUD, radar, and responsive touch controls.

## Objective
- Build a complete, playable rocket-powered soccer game inspired by Rocket League, with a futuristic arena and energetic match presentation.

## Requirements
- Include blue/orange teams, rocket cars, ball, goals, arena, boost pads, crowd, scoreboard, dynamic action, and gameplay controls.
- Save small JPEG screenshots for checks and inspect only the latest screenshot.

## Decisions
- Implemented as a standalone HTML5 Canvas game with no external dependencies.
- Controls: WASD/arrows to drive, Space to jump/flip, Shift to boost, R to reset, Escape or pause button to pause.

## Work State
### Completed
- Added playable game with projected arena, cars, ball, bots, boost pads, goals, scoring, timer, HUD, radar, and responsive touch controls.
- Fixed the browser’s lone console error by adding an inline favicon; reloaded with zero console errors or warnings.
- Confirmed JavaScript syntax with `node --check /tmp/opencode/neon.js`.
- Captured and inspected the menu screenshot at `screenshots/menu.jpg` (1100×720 JPEG).

### Active
- Validate the active match visually and interactively, including driving, jumping, boosting, scoring, pause, and mobile controls; fix any issues found.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Start a match in the browser and inspect the active-game presentation; save and inspect a latest small JPEG screenshot.
2. Test the gameplay controls and match interactions; fix and recheck any defects.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: entire game implementation and UI.
- `screenshots/menu.jpg`: inspected menu screenshot.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted.
- Local server is running at `http://localhost:3002`; browser session is open.
